# JacobPEvans

Repository index for the JacobPEvans GitHub organization.

## Repositories

- [.github](https://github.com/JacobPEvans/.github): Enterprise-central reusable workflows, Renovate preset and CI policy
- [.github-ai](https://github.com/JacobPEvans/.github-ai): Enterprise-central AI workflows: PR-Agent review and agent automation
- [jpe-ai-voice](https://github.com/JacobPEvans/jpe-ai-voice): Personal writing voice guide and Vale style for AI agents
- [tofu-aws-bedrock](https://github.com/JacobPEvans/tofu-aws-bedrock): Deploy an AI-powered assistant with a public API endpoint using AWS Bedrock and Terraform. No authentication required—just send text via curl and get intelligent responses back.
